description: Turns a flow on or off, as its On switch on the Automations page does. Turning it on runs the same publish check (a refusal says what is missing); turning it off ends its runs in progress. flow_id comes from read('flows'). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_flow_on
title: Turn a flow on or off
